verification_commands.ac2:
cd backend && rm -f /tmp/t29ac.db && ENV=development DATABASE_URL=sqlite:////tmp/t29ac.db JWT_SECRET=t29repro-0123456789-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz-abcd1234 STAFF_PIN=0000 TZ=UTC ./.venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "
  import pathlib;pathlib.Path('/tmp/t29ac.db').unlink(missing_ok=True)
  from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
  from app.main import app
  from app import seed
  from app.database import SessionLocal
  db=SessionLocal();seed.seed_data(reset=True);db.close()
  c=TestClient(app,raise_server_exceptions=False)
  t=c.post('/api/v1/auth/login',json={'pin':'0000'}).json()['access_token']
  H={'Authorization':'Bearer '+t}
  r1=c.post('/api/v1/admin/tables',headers=H,json={'label':'T1','capacity':2,'sort_order':9223372036854775808})
  assert r1.status_code==422, ('create sort_order overflow', r1.status_code)
  assert 'sort_order' in (r1.json().get('error',{}).get('details',{}).get('fields',{}) or {}), ('create detail field', r1.text)
  id=c.post('/api/v1/admin/tables',headers=H,json={'label':'T9','capacity':2}).json()['id']
  r3=c.patch('/api/v1/admin/tables/'+id,headers=H,json={'sort_order':9223372036854775808})
  assert r3.status_code==422, ('update sort_order overflow', r3.status_code)
  print('ac2 ok')
  "
